changelog: **Real minutes replace the placeholder log, and action items become to-dos (#1849):** `meetingAutoLog` now prefers the session's `SessionNote` (#1847) pinned to the meeting over the localized "the scheduled meeting took place" placeholder, and minutes written after the row exists update that auto-logged `InteractionLog` in place (`src/lib/minutesSync.ts`) — one meeting stays one log, the sweep stays idempotent, `SWEEP_BATCH`/`SWEEP_LOOKBACK_DAYS`/`SIBLING_BATCH` are untouched, and a log the mentor typed by hand is never overwritten. A `- [ ]` line of the minutes is an action item: `POST /api/session-notes/[id]/action-items` promotes it to a personal `ProjectTask` for the mentor or the mentee (the to-do API's own reach, `project.newTodo` notification), linked by the new `SessionNoteActionItem` row; ticking the to-do rewrites the line as a revision by the ticker and ticking the line (in the panel or by editing the text) ticks the to-do. `GET /api/session-notes?relationId=` adds the pairing's past meetings for the picker and the two seats for the assignee; the panel gains the meeting select, the action-item list with toggles and "Make it a to-do". The mentee's journey and interaction history show the real minutes through the updated log. Unit test `scripts/test/minutes-action-items.test.mjs`; e2e `e2e/minutes-as-log.spec.ts`.

en: Minutes you write for a session now become that meeting's entry in the interaction history, replacing the automatic one-liner. Any line that starts with "- [ ]" is an action item: tick it in the minutes or turn it into a to-do for either of you — the two stay in step.
tr: Bir oturum için yazdığın tutanak artık o toplantının etkileşim geçmişindeki kaydı oluyor ve otomatik tek cümlenin yerine geçiyor. "- [ ]" ile başlayan her satır bir aksiyon maddesi: tutanakta işaretle ya da ikinizden biri için yapılacak yap — ikisi birlikte güncellenir.
de: Das Protokoll, das ihr für eine Sitzung schreibt, wird jetzt zum Eintrag dieses Termins in der Interaktionshistorie und ersetzt den automatischen Einzeiler. Jede Zeile, die mit „- [ ]" beginnt, ist ein Aktionspunkt: im Protokoll abhaken oder für eine von euch zur Aufgabe machen — beides bleibt im Gleichschritt.
